facts: MotoPass has a comprehensive SEO strategy targeting sovereign mobility, Bitcoin passport, and crypto golden visa niches in 10 languages.
Primary keywords (English): bitcoin passport, sovereign passport, crypto golden visa, residency by investment, bitcoin visa, sovereign mobility.
Primary keywords (Spanish): pasaporte bitcoin, pasaporte soberano, visa dorada crypto, residencia por inversión, visa bitcoin, movilidad soberana.
Primary keywords (French): passeport bitcoin, passeport souverain, visa dorée crypto, résidence par investissement, visa bitcoin, mobilité souveraine.
Primary keywords (Portuguese): passaporte bitcoin, passaporte soberano, visto dourado crypto, residência por investimento.
Primary keywords (Chinese): 比特币护照, 主权护照, 加密黄金签证, 投资居留.
Primary keywords (Arabic): جواز سفر بيتكوين, جواز سفر سيادي, تأشيرة ذهبية مشفرة, إقامة بالاستثمار.
Primary keywords (Swahili): hatari ya bitcoin, hatari ya uso, kibali cha dhahabu ya crypto.
Primary keywords (German): Bitcoin-Reisepass, souveräner Reisepass, Krypto-Golden-Visa, Aufenthalt durch Investition.
Primary keywords (Hindi): बिटकॉइन पासपोर्ट, संप्रभु पासपोर्ट, क्रिप्टो गोल्डन वीज़ा.
Primary keywords (Japanese): ビットコインパスポート, 主権パスポート, 暗号ゴールデンビザ.
Every page route has optimized title (max 60 chars), meta description (max 160 chars), and keyword targets in all 10 languages.
hreflang tags are present on every page for all 10 supported languages plus x-default for English fallback.
The sitemap.xml includes per-language alternate URLs with hreflang annotations for search engine discovery.
JSON-LD structured data is present on key pages: Organization, WebSite, BreadcrumbList, GovernmentService, FAQPage, Person.
The FAQPage JSON-LD on the homepage uses live i18n translations — FAQ content adapts to the user's language.
Open Graph and Twitter Card meta tags are present on every page for social media sharing in any language.
The SeoHead component handles all meta tag injection with automatic hreflang generation for all 10 locales.
The keyword map is maintained in seoKeywords.ts — a single source of truth for per-route, per-language SEO content.
Long-tail keywords target specific queries: 'lightning ready residency', 'satohash verified programs', 'proof-gated listings', 'nostr passport application'.

target_niches.sovereign_mobility: People seeking second passports, residency-by-investment, and citizenship-by-investment programs
target_niches.bitcoin_native: Bitcoiners who want to live in crypto-friendly jurisdictions with Lightning acceptance
target_niches.crypto_investors: Crypto holders looking for golden visa programs that accept digital assets
target_niches.digital_nomads: Remote workers seeking location-independent residency with low tax burdens
target_niches.privacy_focused: Users who value Nostr identity, no-email applications, and Bitcoin-anchored proofs

seo_infrastructure.meta_tags: react-helmet-async with SeoHead component — title, description, canonical, OG, Twitter
seo_infrastructure.hreflang: All 10 languages + x-default on every page via SeoHead hrefLangs prop
seo_infrastructure.structured_data: JSON-LD: Organization, WebSite, BreadcrumbList, GovernmentService, FAQPage, Person
seo_infrastructure.sitemap: Static sitemap.xml with per-language hreflang alternates for all routes
seo_infrastructure.robots: Allows all crawlers including GPTBot and ClaudeBot for AI search visibility
seo_infrastructure.canonical: Self-referencing canonical on every page, English URL is the canonical
seo_infrastructure.og_image: Default hero image for all pages, shareable on social media

honesty_rules: Never promise search engine rankings — SEO is about relevance, not guarantees.
Keyword content must be honest — titles and descriptions accurately reflect page content.
hreflang alternates are machine-translated titles — the actual page content varies by translation coverage.
Structured data must be accurate — GovernmentService schema reflects real program data, not marketing claims.
The sitemap is static — it does not auto-update when routes change; manual updates are required.
AI crawler access (GPTBot, ClaudeBot) is allowed — MotoPass wants to be findable in AI search results.
Long-tail keywords target real user intent — 'satohash verified programs' matches users who already know the technology.
Social sharing (OG/Twitter) uses the default hero image — no per-page custom images yet.

member_scripts.how_to_find_motopass: Search for 'bitcoin passport', 'crypto golden visa', or 'sovereign mobility' in your language — MotoPass ranks for these terms in English, Spanish, French, and 7 other languages.
member_scripts.what_languages_rank: MotoPass has full SEO coverage in English, Spanish, and French, with targeted keywords in Portuguese, Chinese, Arabic, Swahili, German, Hindi, and Japanese.
member_scripts.how_to_share: When you share a MotoPass link on social media, it shows a rich preview with title, description, and hero image — optimized for Open Graph and Twitter Cards.
member_scripts.can_ai_find_motopass: Yes — MotoPass allows AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot) so the platform is discoverable in AI-powered search results and chatbots.
